dataset: common-pile/doab (raw version; 13 gzipped JSON-lines shards, PDF -> Markdown by Marker)
files_examined: common-pile/doab_filtered: doab-0000..0004.json.gz (5 shards, 403,992 docs; downloaded to /home/vihaa/CinnamonLM/raw/common_pile_processed/doab/_filtered_ref/, indexed, then deleted)
data_state_note: The per-document metrics pass (raw/report/sample commands) ran on the ORIGINAL raw shards (474,445 docs; metrics written 2026-10-10 10:00-11:45 IST). At 13:45 IST the licence step rewrote the shards in place (licence_applied.json: 395 docs dropped = 235.2M chars, 4,292 credit-line strips = 2.57M chars; 474,050 docs / 12,217,120,546 chars remain). The 'extra' pass and all manual reading used the licence-applied shards. Doc ids are unchanged, so ids in this file resolve in the current shards unless the licence step dropped them (e.g. 4b877d36-0091-4b0b-bdb8-f4f33e96d9d6).

docs_sampled.manual_reading: 105 document excerpts read (head 2-3k chars, middle 1.5-2k, tail 1-1.5k): 31 in batch 1 (1 of 32 selected was licence-dropped; 2 shortest, 2 at p5, 4 longest, 14 random whole books, 10 random sections; shards 00000-00012), 24 in batch 2 (English-share bands, filter-dropped English docs, font-garbled docs, one whole book each of Language Science Press, InTechOpen, Bentham, UCL Press, KIT, transcript, Taylor & Francis), 42 head+middle excerpts from the 'sample' command (English-share bands and filter drops), 8 mixed-language whole books at 5 offsets each. Also 25 random lines per line class (precision check, shard 00005, ~1,200 docs) and the reservoir examples of every issue.
docs_sampled.measured_by_code: all 474,445 docs (metrics pass, original raw) and all 474,050 docs (extra pass, licence-applied)

schema_fields.id_format: '<book uuid>' for a whole book (8,288 docs, 4.51G chars) or '<book uuid>.<section_idx>' for a section of a book split at Marker headings (466,157 docs, 7.95G chars; only IntechOpen 296,457 and MDPI 169,700). Split books: 11,595; sections per book p50 11, max 652. Splitting is uneven: in 3,679 of the split books with >=3 sections one section holds >50% of the book text (e.g. 9ef47a7e-6e36-4f0b-84ec-c0cb93761508.4 = 4,119,662 of 4,125,167 chars), so 'section' docs range from a bare heading (50 chars) to a whole book. Only 6 books span two shards.
schema_fields.text_format: Marker Markdown: '#' headings, **bold**/*italic*, <sup>/<sub> HTML tags, $$...$$ LaTeX display math, backslash-escaped markdown characters; NO markdown tables (0 table rows in 474,445 docs) and almost no image placeholders (28).

length_stats.notes: Char volume is dominated by docs >=100k chars (16,012 + 1,694 docs = 8.81G of 12.45G chars). 47,118 docs are <200 chars (5.6M chars): bare section titles, editor lines, 'Contents' fragments, e.g. 0125951d-801e-4c01-940d-d4ffdd45bf3c.85 = '**6. Other potential therapeutic targets in HCC**'.

language_mix.method: fastText lid.176 (/home/vihaa/CinnamonLM/data_pipeline/models/lid.176.bin). (a) doc level on whitespace-joined lowercased text; (b) chunk level: consecutive paragraphs merged to >=300 chars after removing tags, markup, '$', URLs; chunks with <50% letters skipped; label kept if score>=0.5 else 'uncertain'.
reading_results: Low English share over ALL chunks is mostly NOT foreign language: of the sampled sections with share <0.5, nearly all were English text dominated by LaTeX math, reference lists, author/affiliation lists or Marker font garble (e.g. 7d8866bf-f8ba-45f4-a5c2-bbe7360bed6d.79 share 0.25 = finite-difference equations; 20441714-9d5d-4c7e-8b55-12bac511d446.112 = appendix of equations; e5519bf8-f11d-494d-a4f1-a8cc1bea1adc.148 = MATLAB code). These fall in 'uncertain', so the share must be computed over language-decided chunks only.

Doc-level fastText en score is also depressed by math/references: 11,115 docs have en<=0.5 but only 1,500 docs have a non-English doc label; the Common Pile filter (en>0.5) dropped 11,091 of the 11,115, i.e. it removed English math-heavy sections too.

Truly non-English whole books exist: 49 whole books with English share <0.5 of decided chunks, e.g. 195ebd74-72ef-42ed-aa9c-951293eec527 (Verlag Barbara Budrich, German, 541,836 chars), 21 Firenze University Press Italian volumes/chapters, cefa18b7-2aea-42b0-bfd2-b0d76c7964a9 (Language Science Press, French 1.13M), 4d0c038c-88d6-49d1-a2a9-253ca17f6176 (Portuguese), 5cc01636-c69f-4e73-824b-386a12874194 (Norwegian), a5ff2d3a-3d3c-41a5-ab19-0d522580bb21 (Japanese).

Mixed books (0.3-0.8) are multilingual edited volumes with whole chapters in German/French/Italian next to English chapters (63232ac3-b236-42a8-99d0-907c32451f38 transcript yearbook de/en 0.45; 1a8e9108-5463-49e0-ae0e-9e255389b016 'Entanglements of the Maghreb' fr/en 0.55; 9bd4e9e5-a8c7-40d2-a1a4-f7ed74872645 Carnap volume de/en 0.30) or source editions with translation (19bd841e-a1fb-452f-8422-db29ff22c964 Judaeo-Arabic/Hebrew text + English, 0.75; 8a2802ae-126a-43ef-9a7a-daa8477495bc Saussure French original + English, 0.57).

English monographs with long foreign quotations sit at 0.8-0.95: 7334ad09-51c5-4b23-8b3e-16768bc9c556 'The Atheist's Bible' (fr quotes, 0.85), 24eba420-de60-43be-91a9-9e757d5a8349 (English with Italian quotes). These are English documents that the user decision says to keep.

Sections with real foreign text are usually reference lists in French/Spanish/Portuguese inside English chapters (04da9bbc-be1c-46b7-bdda-cb93bf584ccb.47 fr refs; a4e12729-6e41-4256-bfaf-3e01a3e0e5c5.42 Spanish/French refs).
language_mix.calibrated_proposal: Per document: share = en_chars / (all chunk chars - uncertain chars). Keep >=0.8 (8,184 whole books, 439,927 sections). Drop <0.5 (49 whole books, 605 sections; read list in /home/vihaa/CinnamonLM/raw/common_pile_processed/doab/analysis/whole_lowen.txt). 0.5-0.8 (55 whole books, 409 sections, 35.5M chars) are multilingual collections; see open_questions. Docs with no decidable chunk (21,700 docs, 2.1M chars) are tiny and are handled by the length/content rules.

issues.name: references_bibliography
issues.description: Reference lists, often scrambled into fragments ('2009, 91, (3), 652-63.'), and inline citation lines. Half of the 'References' headings are EMPTY (heading followed by a licence paragraph, next heading or end of doc), mostly MDPI/Frontiers/Springer, so the reference list was not extracted for them (cause unknown); IntechOpen keeps its lists. Some section docs consist only of reference fragments + the next chapter's title page.
issues.measurement_method: REF_HEAD heading switches a 'reference' section until the next heading; outside it, is_reference_line(): [n] prefix, 'n. Surname, X.' prefix, DOI, short numeric fragments with year/page range, or name+year+locator patterns. Precision 23/25 on random lines. Empty heading = next non-blank line is a heading, boilerplate, or end of doc (extra pass).

paragraph_level.method: xxh64 of normalized blank-line paragraphs >=200 chars; 'shared across books' = hash present in >=2 books

interpretation: Exact duplicates: 15,965 redundant docs, mostly tiny cross-book IntechOpen/MDPI template sections (3,057 copies of one 180-char section) but 4,469 redundant docs >=1,000 chars hold 275.4M chars, including whole books uploaded twice under different ids (996040a7-efd6-4cbb-a1e3-6f0c9a176f06 = b06eebbc-e407-48cb-b9e2-1f547da04a88, 2.88M chars; 1b911a62-f9be-46e9-a5cf-45889b219765 = 6ee31538-742c-4835-8973-172785bcae16).

Paragraph containment: 1,487 books have >=95% of their paragraph chars in other books (chapter-level PDFs of Firenze/KIT/Springer volumes that also exist as whole books, MDPI/IntechOpen reprints). Document-level Jaccard does not see these (a chapter is small relative to its book), so containment is the required measure.
Within-book near duplicates (1,776 of 2,310 pairs at J>=0.8): IntechOpen section '.0' (preface/front block) vs the last section (back-cover blurb repeating the preface).
Cross-book boilerplate paragraphs: the largest groups (34,211 copies of a 204-char paragraph in 2,791 books) are licence/ad paragraphs; 5.9% of paragraph chars are redundant copies.

filtered_comparison.what_common_pile_did_for_doab (paper 250: fastText English score >0.5; length >200 chars; toxicity span deletion (min_score 0.1, sentence spans replaced by empty string); regex PII replacement; no doab line regex; global Bloom-filter dedup (doc is a duplicate if >90% of its 20-grams were already seen).

dropped_by_language.note: 11,091 of 11,115 docs with doc-level en<=0.5 dropped; most of these are English math/reference-heavy sections, not foreign text (see language_mix). All 110 de, 219 fr, 120 it, 482 es, 302 pt doc-label docs dropped, including the multilingual books.

dropped_not_explained_by_length_or_langu.breakdown: 9,650 have an exact twin in raw (277.7M chars); 325 more are near-dup redundant; 7,473 (42.1M chars, 86% IntechOpen sections) remain; in a 400-doc sample of such drops >1000 chars from shard 00003, 70% have >=90% of their >=200-char paragraphs present elsewhere in the corpus, consistent with the 20-gram Bloom dedup; the other 27% (<50% shared paragraphs) are not explained (cause unknown).

observations: PII: e-mails, phones, IPs replaced by placeholders (<EMAIL_ADDRESS> 750, <IP_ADDRESS> 255, <PHONE_NUMBER> 104 in the sample). Some <IP_ADDRESS> replacements hit numeric strings that are not IP addresses (counted, not verified individually).

Toxicity span deletion removed 1,475 sentences (107k chars) in 737 diffed docs; the deleted sentences read are ordinary scientific text ('Hyperandrogenism accompanies increased intra-abdominal fat storage in normal weight polycystic ovary syndrome women.' 3672ca38-68e6-4090-8c35-4650e62ef985.45; 'They include dogs, cats, ferrets, pet birds, rodents, rabbits, guinea pigs ...' 3b5d52b8-cdca-4435-ad6f-bd10be83c60f.52), i.e. the deletion damages text and leaves broken paragraphs.

No PDF-artifact cleaning: line-level issue rates in kept docs equal raw rates (boilerplate 2.18% chars kept vs 2.18% raw; references 4.69% vs 4.62%; running headers 0.275% vs 0.273%; 32 of 137 font-garbled docs kept).
Dropped set is 72.6% tiny docs (<30 body words).

inline_statements_still_present: Compilation-level restrictions remain in 11,725 docs (IntechOpen 6,131, MDPI 5,444, Bentham 74): the BOOK AS A WHOLE is 'all rights reserved' (IntechOpen) or CC BY-NC-ND (MDPI, Bentham), while each chapter/article states CC BY 3.0/4.0. The docs that carry the notice are mostly the front-matter section of a split book (e.g. 01b85ee8-7f8e-45be-846b-a1567421682f.1).

Frontiers e-books: 1,755 docs carry 'Frontiers Copyright Statement ... All rights reserved ... compilation of articles constituting this e-book ... is the exclusive property of Frontiers ... Individual articles may be downloaded and reproduced in accordance with the principles of the CC-BY licence ... They may not be re-sold as an e-book.' Each article in the e-book carries its own CC BY statement.
Partial statements (177 whole books, mostly KIT): text CC BY(-SA) 'excluding the cover, pictures and graphs' – restriction covers non-text parts only.
Common Pile README: books were kept only if a whitelisted open-licence statement appears in front/back matter; licence laundering is possible (paper §2.1).

recommended_steps.step: Resolve the licence question for compilation-level notices before cleaning (user decision): keep chapter/article text that carries its own CC BY statement and remove the compilation notice paragraphs, or drop the affected books.
recommended_steps.rationale: User rule: an inline statement overrides metadata and a restriction of the whole work drops the document. Here the restriction targets the compilation, the chapters state CC BY.
recommended_steps.evidence: 11,725 docs with COMPILATION_RESTRICTION; 1,755 Frontiers e-book statements; examples in issues.compilation_level_licence_notices

recommended_steps.step: Rebuild books: concatenate IntechOpen/MDPI section docs per book_id in section_idx order, then drop front/back-matter units (editor page, contents, 'We are IntechOpen' ad, author details, acknowledgements/funding/COI/data availability, references, index, back cover) at heading boundaries; or keep the split but drop sections that are only such blocks and tiny sections (<30 body words).
recommended_steps.rationale: Section docs are heading-split fragments (13.8% have <30 body words) and some 'sections' contain the whole book; per-section dedup and filtering on fragments is noisy.
recommended_steps.evidence: structure + tiny_doc + frontback_section prevalence; 3,679 split books with one section >50% of text

recommended_steps.step: Remove boilerplate lines/blocks with publisher-specific rules: licence/copyright paragraphs, ISBN/ISSN/DOI/CIP lines, IntechOpen running heads with DOI, 'Additional information ...', correspondence/address lines (also removes PII), MDPI 'Publisher's Note'/'Citation:'/'Received:' lines, Frontiers 'Edited by/Reviewed by/Specialty section', proof stamps, cover credits, publisher catalogue ads; and whole-book front matter before the first Introduction/Preface heading after checking the dropped text is non-prose.
recommended_steps.rationale: Boilerplate is in 44% of docs (99.8% of whole books); line classes reach 25/25 non-prose precision.
recommended_steps.evidence: line:boilerplate 2.18% chars, admin_statement 0.74%, front matter 2.3% of whole-book chars

recommended_steps.step: Remove reference/bibliography sections (from a References/Bibliography heading to the next non-reference heading), index tails (after the last Index heading in the final 25%) and TOC blocks; drop empty 'References' headings and orphan 'Table N.' captions.
recommended_steps.rationale: Reference lists are 4.6% of chars (9.8% in IntechOpen) and are often scrambled fragments; indexes are page-number lists.
recommended_steps.evidence: line:reference, index_tail 20.8M chars in 1,717 docs, 38,583 docs with empty reference headings, 469,525 orphan table captions

recommended_steps.step: Remove page furniture lines: bare page numbers, repeated book-title+page running heads (per-doc repeat detection), MDPI 'x FOR PEER REVIEW n of m' and Frontiers proof stamps; then join paragraphs that were split around the removed line when the first part ends without sentence punctuation and the next starts lowercase.
recommended_steps.rationale: Running heads and page numbers interrupt sentences; 836k paragraph pairs are joined directly and 48k are interrupted by a header/page number.
recommended_steps.evidence: line:running_header (19/25 precision: require repeat + number edge, exclude numeric lines), paragraph_flow

recommended_steps.step: Repair inline extraction artifacts: de-hyphenate 'word‐ word' when the joined form is a known word (dictionary or same-doc vocabulary); restore dropped fi/fl/ff ligatures and re-join space-split ligature words with the same dictionary test; map IntechOpen symbol-font characters (¼ -> =, þ -> +, � -> −, ð Þ -> ( )) only inside math-like spans; convert or strip Markdown markers and <sup>/<sub> footnote markers (keep chemical/units sub/superscripts as plain text, drop footnote numbers after words).
recommended_steps.rationale: These are deterministic and validated by dictionary lookups; Springer/OBP books carry ~400/~260 ligature drops per 1M chars.
recommended_steps.evidence: hyphen_break_validated 858,090 matches; ligature_drop 603,245; split_word 23,731; math_font_garble 590,556 matches in 9,052 docs

recommended_steps.step: Drop documents that are unreadable: font-garbled docs (Latin-Extended symbol text, Caesar shift with >=5 tokens after excluding Japanese romaji), and docs whose body-paragraph lowercase-start rate is very high (calibrate the threshold on read samples; older IntechOpen books).
recommended_steps.rationale: Repair is not possible for font garble; heavy reading-order damage cannot be fixed reliably.
recommended_steps.evidence: 137 garbled docs (105 already dropped by CP), IntechOpen lowercase-start rate 24.7% vs Springer 6.5%

recommended_steps.step: English filter per document on English share of language-decided chunks (exclude 'uncertain' math/reference chunks): keep >=0.8, drop <0.5, decide 0.5-0.8 per open question; do NOT use doc-level fastText en>0.5 alone.
recommended_steps.rationale: Doc-level score drops English math sections; decided-chunk share separates foreign books from English books with quotes (read samples).
recommended_steps.evidence: language_mix.reading_results; 11,091 doc-level drops by CP; 49/55/205 whole books in <0.5/0.5-0.8/0.8-0.95

recommended_steps.step: Deduplicate in three levels after cleaning: exact (normalized text hash), document near-dup (MinHash J>=0.8), and containment (fraction of a doc's >=200-char paragraphs or 13/20-grams present in another doc; drop chapter-level PDFs contained in whole books, keep the larger/cleaner copy); run the same across sources later.
recommended_steps.rationale: Whole books exist twice under different ids; 1,487 books are >=95% contained in other books; Jaccard alone misses chapters inside books.
recommended_steps.evidence: exact_dup 275.4M chars in docs >=1000 chars; paragraph_dup books_with_cross_book_shared_paragraph_share; 9,650 CP drops with exact twin

recommended_steps.step: Do not reuse the Common Pile toxicity span deletion; if PII handling is needed, remove the correspondence/address lines as boilerplate instead of inserting placeholders.
recommended_steps.rationale: Read deleted sentences were benign scientific text and deletion leaves broken paragraphs; placeholders add tokens that do not occur in natural text.

recommended_steps.step: Before the full in-place rewrite, run the cleaner on 5 real shards' worth of samples (shortest, longest, each publisher, each English band) and read removed text per rule.
recommended_steps.rationale: Line classes have 76-100% precision; thresholds (running header, lowercase-start rate, glued words) need calibration on removed text.

open_questions: Licence: are compilation-level notices (IntechOpen 'book as a whole all rights reserved', MDPI/Bentham 'book as a whole CC BY-NC-ND', Frontiers e-book 'All rights reserved') a restriction of the whole work (drop) or of the compilation only (keep the CC BY chapters, remove the notice)? 11,725 + 1,755 docs; IntechOpen and MDPI are 64% of doab chars.

Language: multilingual whole books with 0.5-0.8 English share (55 whole books, 409 sections, 35.5M chars; e.g. 63232ac3-b236-42a8-99d0-907c32451f38, 1a8e9108-5463-49e0-ae0e-9e255389b016) contain whole foreign-language chapters. Keep whole, drop whole, or remove the non-English chapters (this changes a document, not only decides it)?
Section docs: rebuild books from sections before cleaning and dedup, or keep the Common Pile section split?
Why half of the 'References' headings have no entries (MDPI/Frontiers/Springer) is unknown; it does not change the cleaning rule but means reference removal affects mainly IntechOpen.
7,473 docs dropped by the Common Pile filter (42.1M chars) are not explained by length, language, exact or near duplication; 27% of a sample also lack paragraph containment. Cause unknown.
Threshold for dropping reading-order-damaged docs (lowercase-start rate) is not yet calibrated on read samples.
Metrics come from the original raw shards; 395 licence-dropped docs and 4,292 stripped docs differ from the current shards (0.08% of docs, 1.9% of chars).
